title: G1 registry: agent is a Claude Code skill key, not house debt
description: Claude Code reads agent on skills (CHANGELOG 2.1.0 and the 2.1.101 fix for context: fork plus agent), and the ork build already forwards it. The G1 registry now lists it as a skill key instead of a house key, so 49 forked skills stop counting as debt: 977 to 928.
